COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Bhushan International is a leading industrial solutions and engineering services organization headquartered in Patna, with over four decades of industry presence since 1985. The company specializes in Water Management, Industrial Air Solutions, Garage Automation, Industrial Chemicals, and Turnkey Projects, serving diverse sectors including manufacturing industries, healthcare institutions, infrastructure projects, power plants, and government organizations.

Bhushan International is an authorized channel partner of globally recognized brands such as KSB, ELGi, ATS ELGi, ION Exchange, and other industrial solution providers. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, service excellence, and technological advancement, the company has established itself as one of the most trusted industrial solution providers across Bihar, Jharkhand, and neighbouring industrial regions.
